ValidationRule.description: A valid HTTP header name (RFC 9110 token characters), and not one Replayr or the platform sets itself. UPPER uses en_US so the check does not depend on the user locale.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use a valid header name such as Idempotency-Key, with no spaces or colons. Headers the platform or Replayr sets (Authorization, Content-Type, Content-Length, Host, Connection, Cookie, Expect, Transfer-Encoding, Upgrade) can't be used.
